h2: NDT training programs in the USA: which route fits, and what you leave with
html:
Search for NDT training in the US and you get three very different things under one name: full-time schools, method courses from training providers, and self-paced online theory. All three can lead to a job. What differs is what you hold at the end, how long it takes, and whether an employer can certify you on the back of it, because under ASNT SNT-TC-1A the employer certifies, not the course.

The three routes, side by side

  • An NDT school or college program (an NDT school in the search results) teaches several methods over months, with materials, welding and math. It suits someone with no industry contact who wants a broad start, and it is the slowest route.
  • Method courses, also sold as NDT classes or NDT training courses, cover one method and one level at a time and supply the formal training hours a written practice asks for. Most working technicians add methods this way.
  • Self-paced online theory now comes from several sources, including professional bodies such as the American Welding Society. It counts toward the classroom hours in SNT-TC-1A, but no online course includes the hands-on practical, and the hours of supervised experience still have to be earned on the job.

What an NDT training program has to include for an employer to certify you

A useful NDT training program covers four things, not one: the method theory, the hands-on practical, the experience hours, and the general, specific and practical examinations under the employer's written practice. NDT technician training that stops at theory leaves the employer to arrange the rest. NDT inspector training for in-service work adds the codes the plant works to, such as ASME Section V or AWS D1.1.

How Atlantis delivers it

Theory is self-paced on the Atlantis portal, with questions answered by an ASNT NDT Level III, so online NDT training can start the day you enrol, anywhere in the country. The practical is done twice: first in the Practical NDT simulator, then hands-on at the employer's own facility, where the parts and the procedures are. For employers we can administer the examinations and prepare the certification records under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A; for individuals, the course records support certification by the employer you join or ASNT central certification.

Start with the level you need: NDT Level 1 training, NDT Level 2 training or ASNT Level III preparation. Check where a technician stands with the SNT-TC-1A eligibility check, try a method in the free practice tests, and see the whole catalogue on the NDT training page.
